provenance.scope: Original two trimmed NativeLabel source/Image/SIS/draw/frame records, reduced to the fields consumed by native_label_fonts. Draw callbacks, actual face names/axes, sign identity and all supplied checkpoint states are unchanged. Unrelated labels, geometry/paint/readback bytes and unconsumed fields are omitted. This fixture is not final PNG or whole-capture evidence.
